system.longDesc:
Cost: 4 SP

In addition to the stunts listed here, pilots also have access to the following Command stunts at the same SP cost: Blinding Maneuver, Evasive Action, On-Target, Misdirect, and Set-Up.

The pilot maneuvers the ship to make it difficult for an enemy ship to fire on or pursue its chosen target (unless that target is the pilot’s ship). The enemy ship suffers a 2 penalty to any maneuver test to pursue or attack its original target, or the targeted ship gets a +2 to its evasion test. The PCs ship must remain within Close range of the ship they are protecting.
